name: Lead Green Green Tokens API
description: GPU watt-hours per million output tokens by model, GPU and configuration, with grid carbon intensity and GPU hardware reference data. Static JSON, GET only, CORS open.

endpoints.description: Sources, versions, retrieval dates, licences and this endpoint list.
The index: 32 rows, one per model and GPU, energy-optimal under the latency limit, sorted ascending.
Every model on the index with its slug, Hugging Face id, parameter counts and measured GPUs.
One model: every measured configuration (concurrency, parallelism, latency, power) and the best row per GPU.
Grid emissions intensity, gCO2e per kWh, 2024 annual average, 193 countries plus World.
Manufacturer power ceilings, memory, MIG slice profiles and one embodied-carbon figure.
AI Energy Score text-generation rows: Wh per 1,000 queries at batch size 1 on one H100.

caveat: GPU energy only, measured at steady state on a busy server (the most energy-efficient configuration under a latency limit). Host, network, cooling and idle time are not counted. Every figure is a floor; a lightly used server sits well above it.
